title: 第2612章 拓跋家族臣服第2611章 拓跋家族被灭
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
金云霄见到楚云冲向拓跋云苍，顿时大惊。
“快回来！”
然而楚云速度极快。
眨眼间，便已经来到拓跋云苍身前。
拓跋云苍见楚云冲来，先是一怔，随即露出狰狞笑容。
“小子，既然你想找死，那老夫就先送你上路！”
说话间，他加快速度催动体内星力。
可就在这时。
楚云猛地抬起手掌，对着拓跋云苍施展吞天诀。
嗡！
只见一股强大的吞噬之力，从楚云掌心爆发出来，将拓跋云苍笼罩住。
拓跋云苍脸上的笑容，瞬间凝固。
他发现自己的身体，好像被一股无形力量禁锢住了。
不管他如何催动星力，都无法挣脱。
不仅如此。
他体内原本疯狂涌动的星力，居然开始朝着楚云的手掌快速流去。
“怎么回事？”
拓跋云苍脸色大变。
他猛地抬起头，看着楚云怒道：“小子，你对老夫做了什么？”
楚云神情冷漠，道：“你不是要自爆吗？”

“看你体内的星力如此浑厚，正好免费帮你吸收一点。”
“你找死！”
拓跋云苍怒吼道：“快放开老夫！”
楚云冷笑道：“放开你？”
“好让你自爆杀我们吗？”
随着这话响起，楚云再次加大吞天诀的吞噬力度。
“啊！”
体内星力被强行抽走，拓跋云苍发出一声痛苦的惨叫。
只见他的身体，开始以肉眼可见的速度干瘪下去。
“住手，快住手！”
拓跋云苍拼命挣扎。
但是他本来就身受重伤，加上强行催动星力自爆，体内经脉已经受到重创。
如今面对吞天诀的吞噬，他根本没有丝毫反抗之力。
“这……这是什么星法？”
“居然能够强行吞噬别人的星力？”
围观的人里面，那些没有见过楚云施展吞天诀的人，见到这恐怖的一幕，纷纷露出震惊之色。
跟这些人不同。
金云霄见到楚云施展出这样的手段，眼中闪过一抹异样之色。
他低声自语道：“这难道是传说中，噬天镜自带的星法？”
“传说此法能强行吞噬别人的星力，修炼到极致，还可以吞天噬地。

原本老夫以为只是传说，想不到居然是真的。
如此看来，噬天镜很有可能在这小子身上。”
随着吞天诀不断运转。
content_en:
Jin Yunxiao was shocked when he saw Chu Yun rushing towards Tuoba Yuncang.
"Come back quickly!"
However, Chu Yun was extremely fast.
In the blink of an eye, he had arrived in front of Tuoba Yuncang.
When Tuoba Yuncang saw Chu Yun rushing towards him, he was startled for a moment, and then showed a ferocious smile.
"Boy, since you want to seek death, I will send you on your way first!"
As he spoke, he sped up to activate the star power in his body.
But at this moment.
Chu Yun suddenly raised his palm and used the Heaven Swallowing Technique at Tuoba Yuncang.
Buzz!
A powerful devouring power burst out from Chu Yun's palm, covering Tuoba Yuncang.
The smile on Tuoba Yuncang's face froze instantly.
He found that his body seemed to be imprisoned by an invisible force.
No matter how hard he activated his star power, he couldn't break free.
Not only that.
The star power that was originally surging crazily in his body actually began to flow rapidly towards Chu Yun's palm.
"What's going on?"
Tuoba Yuncang's expression changed drastically.
He raised his head suddenly, looked at Chu Yun and said angrily: "Boy, what did you do to me?"
Chu Yun looked indifferent and said, "Aren't you going to blow yourself up?"
"Looking at how rich the star power is in your body, I can help you absorb it for free."
"You're looking for death!"
Tuoba Yuncang roared: "Let me go quickly!"
Chu Yun sneered: "Let you go?"
"So that you can blow yourself up and kill us?"
As these words rang out, Chu Yun once again increased the intensity of the Devouring Heaven Technique.
"Ah!"
The star power in his body was forcibly taken away, and Tuoba Yuncang let out a painful scream.
His body began to dry up at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"Stop it, stop it!"
Tuoba Yuncang struggled desperately.
However, he was seriously injured to begin with, and the meridians in his body had been severely damaged due to the forced activation of his star power to self-destruct.
Now facing the Devouring Heaven Technique, he had no power to resist at all.
"This... what kind of star method is this?"
"Can you actually forcibly swallow other people's star power?"
Among the onlookers, those who had never seen Chu Yun perform the Heaven Swallowing Technique showed shock when they saw this terrifying scene.
Not like these people.
When Jin Yunxiao saw Chu Yun using such methods, a strange look flashed in his eyes.
He whispered to himself: "Is this the legendary star method that comes with the Sky-Eating Mirror?"
"It is said that this method can forcibly swallow other people's star power. When practiced to the extreme, it can even swallow the sky and the earth.
I originally thought it was just a legend, but I didn't expect it to be true.
From this point of view, it is very likely that the Sky-Eating Mirror is on this kid. "
As the Heaven Swallowing Technique continues to operate.
